name: The Crystal Archives
realm: Store many values in a row of crystals.

trial.prompt: What's the index of the FIRST element of an array?
How do you add an element to the end of a vector v?

boss.prompt: The Hydra's array has 5 heads. What's wrong?
options: b) Out of bounds - valid indexes are 0..4
boss.explain: heads[5] is one past the end: undefined behaviour!

spell.prompt: Write int largest(const vector<int>& v) that returns the biggest element (the vector is never empty).
spell.hint: Start best = v[0], then loop over the rest. (Don't start at 0 - negatives!)
